_comment: Sample cart contents keyed by the demo user who owns them (see dummy-data/users/users.json). Applied via repeated POST /api/cart/items {productId, quantity}. Product ids are assigned by the DB at insert time, so seed.js resolves each sku here to its actual id after creating the catalog.

carts.note: Only 3 units of this product are in stock -- a good manual test for the near-empty stock warning and for racing two checkouts against it.
Deliberately left empty -- exercises the empty-cart UI state.
